source.name: ExxonMobil – ExxonMobil to Become Red Bull Racing's Official Fuel and Lubricant Partner
source.quote: ExxonMobil announced today that it will become the Red Bull Racing Formula 1™ team's official fuel, lubricant and motor oil partner in 2017

note: ExxonMobil (Mobil 1 / Esso) became Red Bull Racing's official fuel and lubricant partner from 2017.
